_what_this_is: The near miss beside this file against a repository that has published nothing, which is the state this repository is in today. It has to pass, and it has to say why it passed. What a raised floor strands is an install somebody made, and there is none, so the rule declines rather than asking for an entry against a release nobody can read it next to. The decline is what runs on every real pull request here until the first release, so it is the arm most worth proving.
